heard: A car-sized robot is climbing a mountain taller than Mount Everest. This is Eiolis Mons, an enormous central peak rising inside Mars' Gale Crater. At 5.5 kilometers tall, this Martian giant easily dwarfs Seattle's Mount Rainier. In fact, its vertical rise from base to peak is greater than Mount Everest's. This mountain consists of ancient sedimentary layers, eroded over billions of years by Martian winds. In August 2012, NASA's car-sized Curiosity rover landed inside the wide crater basin. Using its robotic drill, Curiosity discovered organic chemicals locked inside these ancient lakebed layers. To investigate if Mars once supported life, this tireless, car-sized robot is still climbing.
